classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class that handles HTTP requests to a REST API, with methods for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE operations, JSON serialization/deserialization, and error handling with toast notifications.

methods.name: .ctor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes HttpClient, ToastService, and base API URL from configuration.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URI and deserializes the JSON response into the specified generic type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified URI with an optional ID and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON-serialized data and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with JSON-serialized data and deserializes the response.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON StringContent for HTTP request body.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes an HttpResponseMessage content into the specified generic type, handling errors and showing toast notifications.
